description: NaPrCP₂H₄O₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five PCO₃ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.54 Å. Pr is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Pr-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.65 Å. C is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to two P and two H atoms. Both C-P bond lengths are 1.82 Å. Both C-H bond lengths are 1.10 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to one C and three O atoms to form PCO₃ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one PCO₃ tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.57 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to one C and three O atoms to form PCO₃ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one PCO₃ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There is one shorter (1.54 Å) and two longer (1.55 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.97 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one C atom. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one C atom. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Pr, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Pr, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, two equivalent Pr, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Pr and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Pr, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Pr and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a water-like geometry to one Pr and two H atoms.
